blur_detection.description: The receipt image is clear with sharp text and well-defined edges throughout the document.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed as the text clarity is sufficient for accurate OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt exhibits excellent contrast between the black text and white background, enabling clear visibility of all textual content.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No improvement needed for contrast as the current level is optimal for data extraction.

glare_identification.description: No visible glare, reflections, or overexposed regions detected on the receipt surface.
glare_identification.recommendation: Current lighting conditions are ideal; maintain similar environment for future document captures.

water_stains.description: No water damage, discoloration, or staining visible on any part of the receipt.
water_stains.recommendation: Continue to keep receipts dry and protected from liquid exposure.

tears_or_folds.description: The receipt appears flat with no visible tears, creases, or fold lines that would affect text recognition.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Continue to handle and store receipts carefully to maintain this level of physical integrity.

cut_off_detection.description: All edges of the receipt are fully visible with no content appearing to be cut off from the frame.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Current framing technique is excellent; continue to ensure full document capture.

missing_sections.description: The receipt appears complete with all expected sections visible including header, line items, totals, and payment information.
missing_sections.recommendation: Continue capturing full documents to ensure all relevant data is available for extraction.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows, or other objects obstructing any part of the receipt content.
obstructions.recommendation: Maintain current capture technique to avoid introducing obstructions.
